claims.evidence: No brand logo, model number, or size reference visible in the photo; screen only shows a reflection.

claims.claim: No dead pixel, no line on the screen
claims.evidence: Screen is off in the photo; a powered-on shot or video is needed to check for dead pixels or lines.
No remote visible in the photo, but it may simply be out of frame; needs a dedicated photo.
Back panel and internals are not shown, so prior repair or opened casing cannot be confirmed or denied.

risks.risk: Actual brand/model may not be Samsung, affecting value
risks.proof: Photo of the brand logo/label or the model sticker on the back panel

risks.risk: Screen size may differ from claimed 55 inches
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure across the screen or the size label on the back
risks.if_unproven: price at smaller-size worst case until size is confirmed

risks.risk: TV may not power on or may have display defects not visible when off
risks.proof: Video clip of the TV powering on, showing a full picture or test pattern

risks.risk: Remote, power cable, or stand may be missing
risks.proof: Photo showing the TV together with remote, power cable, and stand
risks.if_unproven: price as TV only, no accessories

risks.risk: Back panel damage, port condition, or signs of prior repair
risks.proof: Clear photo of the back panel including ports and screws
risks.if_unproven: price as condition unknown, assume possible port/repair issues

proof_requests: Photo of the brand logo and model/serial sticker on the back of the TV
Photo with a tape measure showing actual screen size
Video of the TV powering on and displaying content
Photo of the remote, power cable, and stand alongside the TV
Clear photo of the back panel showing ports and overall condition
response.reason: The witness confirms a flat-screen TV, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified brand/size, unconfirmed working state, no accessories), with upside pending the listed proofs.
